name: The Guardian
body: Preloaded HSTS, a Permissions-Policy, security.txt, and Core Web Vitals that pass for real visitors. But the international and UK front pages have no h1, so screen-reader users lose the first heading.
lesson: Give every page one h1 that names it, even a visually hidden one on a front page. Headings are how many people navigate.
summary: www.theguardian.com scores 78 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 15 are at risk, and 23 pass. Fix first: 5 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.

fix.title: 5 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked
fix.evidence: Claude-SearchBot (Claude search) by Disallow: /, Claude-User (Claude, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /, PerplexityBot (Perplexity answers) by Disallow: /, Amazonbot (Alexa answers) by Disallow: /, DuckAssistBot (DuckAssist answers) by…
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: 20 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 110 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: 2 cookies are sent without Secure
fix.evidence: Without Secure: gu_client_ab_tests, gu_v2_mvt_id. Set on /international, /film/2026/oct/19/you-can-see-everything-movie-spoilers-success, /commentisfree/2026/oct/19/saudi-arabia-trump-relationship and 17 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: 14 pages do not have exactly one h1
fix.fix: Give each page one h1 that names it.

fix.title: Lighthouse scores performance 39/100 on mobile
fix.evidence: Lighthouse 13.5.0 on a simulated mid-range phone over slow 4G: Largest Contentful Paint 15.1 s, Total Blocking Time 161 ms, Cumulative Layout Shift 0.395, Speed Index 6.7 s.
fix.fix: Open PageSpeed Insights for this URL and work through its opportunities, largest savings first.
